newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY CLOSES JUST BELOW C.BANK INTERVENTION LEVEL.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY CLOSES JUST BELOW C.BANK INTERVENTION LEVEL.

text.p: 1230 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at 1.53/1.47 pct from the trading band centre, stronger than Wednesday's 1.53/1.26 pct after a central bank currency-buying intervention cooled the zloty's rise in early trade, dealers said.
* It closed at 3.1965/85 to the dollar, up from 3.1970/070 on Wednesday and at 1.8785/95 to the mark, up from 1.8880/20.
* C.bank bought an estimated $20 million worth of dollars between 1.62 and 1.47 percent from parity.
* O/N tumble on the last day of the monthly reserve to end at 6.00/16.00 pct vs opening's 24.50/24.99. T/N close flat at 23.50/24.00 pct. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
